about: First-load JavaScript budgets, gzipped, in KiB, checked by `npm run size:routes -- --check` (CI, after the build). Four target pages (Home, Expenses, To-dos, Reminders) are 20% under the PF1 baseline; every other page is held to its PF1 baseline. These are PF1's proposed budgets, in use until George agrees or changes them (docs/performance.md, Waiting for George, row 2). To change one, edit its number here; the check allows tolerancePercent over it. A new page needs a line here, a removed page's line has to go.
